Group `d` Step 6b is materially closed on disk. I wrote the durable artifacts at [frontier-19-alpha-d-6b.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-alpha-d-6b.md), [frontier-19-alpha-d-6b-decisions.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-alpha-d-6b-decisions.json), [frontier-19-alpha-d-6b-ledger-rows.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-alpha-d-6b-ledger-rows.json), and [frontier-19-alpha-d-6b-published-repairs.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-19-alpha-d-6b-published-repairs.json). That includes 26 stamped decisions, 26 appended defect-ledger rows, and 2 published-repair receipts.

The substantive repairs were:
- `thm-worpitzky-identity`: fixed the out-of-range binomial step with an explicit case split.
- `thm-bose-construction-produces-a-steiner-triple-system`: narrowed to `m >= 1`.
- `thm-steiner-triple-systems-exist-exactly-when-v-congruent-one-or-three-mod-six`: narrowed to the library’s exact `v > 3` range and synced the page summary.
- `thm-a-finite-family-with-the-erdos-hajnal-property-is-viral`: fixed step `7.2` by separating the `h > 2t` zero-probability case.
- The two published Erdős–Hajnal dependency items now carry the correct arXiv title metadata, with stale verification stamps removed.

Local checks that are green on the final group-`d` state:
- `reflow` + `precheck` on the 6 materially edited items.
- `proof-contract --strict` on batches `5`, `6`, and `10`.
- `citation-fidelity` on batches `5`, `6`, and `10`.
- Item-scoped `risk-report --require-reviewed` on every changed high/critical carrier.
- `defect-ledger validate --run frontier-19`.

The full adjudication routing gate is still blocked for reasons outside this group’s writable queue:
- `research/frontier-19-reader-findings-5.json` still names batch `frontier-19-batch-5` instead of `5`.
- Groups `a` and `b` already have frontier-19 Step-6 ledger rows, but their matching `...-6b-decisions.json` files are not yet present, so `step6-scope check --phase adjudicate` reports global `ledger-unowned` rows.

I did not mutate that frozen reader artifact or invent other groups’ decisions.
